guide.title: Set up post-processing for free
guide.intro: Post-processing tidies your dictation with an AI model: punctuation, grammar, or a rewrite in the style you ask for. Silktone does not include a model, so you connect one. Each option below is free to start; open one to see the steps.

groq.name: Groq
groq.summary: Free plan, no card. Very fast open-source models.
steps: Open the Groq console and sign in with Google or email.
Click “Create API Key”, give it any name, and copy the key. It is shown only once.
In API below, choose Groq as the provider and paste the key.
Press the refresh button next to Model and pick a model. The one below is a good start.
groq.note: The free plan limits how many requests you can make per minute and per day. That is plenty for dictation.

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.summary: Free plan, no card. Open-source models with a daily allowance.
steps: Open Cerebras Cloud and create a free account.
Go to API Keys, create a key, and copy it.
In API below, choose Cerebras as the provider and paste the key.
Press the refresh button next to Model and pick one from the list.
cerebras.note: Model names change over time. If the one below is not in the list, pick any Llama or GPT-OSS model.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.summary: One key for many models. Free ones end in “:free”.
steps: Open OpenRouter and sign in.
Create a key on the Keys page and copy it.
In API below, choose OpenRouter as the provider and paste the key.
Press the refresh button next to Model and pick a model whose name ends in “:free”.
openrouter.note: Free models allow about 50 requests a day and change often. If one stops working, pick another “:free” model.

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.summary: Free key from Google AI Studio. Uses the Custom provider.
steps: Open Google AI Studio and sign in with your Google account.
Click “Create API key” and copy it.
In API below, choose Custom as the provider and paste the base URL shown here.
Paste the key, press the refresh button next to Model, and pick a Flash model.
gemini.note: On the free plan Google may use what you send to improve its products. Avoid it for confidential text.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.summary: Runs on this PC. Free forever, nothing leaves your computer.
steps: Download and install Ollama.
Open Command Prompt, paste the command below, and wait for the download to finish (about 2 GB).
In API below, choose Custom as the provider. The base URL is already filled in.
Type anything as the API key, then enter the model name below.
ollama.note: Needs a reasonably modern PC with at least 8 GB of memory. It is slower than the online options but fully private.

guide.afterSetup: When the provider is set up, choose a prompt that says how your text should be cleaned up, then dictate with the post-processing shortcut instead of the normal one.
guide.privacy: With an online provider, the transcribed text is sent to that service. Your audio never leaves this computer.
